Please support our channel and cat efforts!
We take care of several colonies in our Shenandoah Valley community. 100+ cats are fed daily with adequate food and shelter throughout the community.
We trapped, spayed, and neutered, over 750 cats so far.  With over 400 adoptions. ALL of the cats that are spayed and neutered are taken care of or adopted out. 
    We are grateful for our supporters. And our local humane society for supporting our cause with free spay and neuter services!
 Follow us on our journeys and the ups and downs of cat rescue 💜 🐈
